title: Can Performant LLMs Be Ethical? Quantifying the Impact of Web Crawling Opt-Outs
reasoning: The paper investigates the impact of ethical data sourcing—specifically respecting web-crawling opt-outs via robots.txt—on the performance of Large Language Models. While the title and the motivation are rooted in data ethics and copyright compliance, the benchmarks used to evaluate the models focus on general knowledge, factuality, and domain-specific information (e.g., medical and scientific facts) rather than religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or spiritual traditions.
